reasons.action: The request explicitly asks the woman to ride the dragon into a battleground, which is a new performed action; the reference sheets provide static presentation poses and their pose is not licensed.
reasons.medium: The medium decision preserves the reference rendering, and the request supplies only a cinematic/dramatic descriptive phrase rather than a specific rendering process, so the reference medium governs.
reasons.wardrobe: The named technical jacket is explicitly requested and governs that wardrobe property; the other observed clothing items remain reference-derived, but the wardrobe attribute is request-governed because an explicit clothing request exists.
reasons.lighting: No explicit light source, direction, or visible light quality is requested; cinematic and dramatic are style/mood terms rather than lighting instructions, so reference lighting governs.
reasons.framing: The brief explicitly requests camera movements, which is an actual camera instruction; the 16:9 aspect alone would not govern framing, but the requested movement makes framing request-governed.
reasons.palette: No explicit color grade, hue, saturation, or tonal contrast instruction is given; cinematic and dramatic phrasing does not select a palette, so reference palette governs.
